_comment: Edit this file to curate the home page. No code needed. Sections render top to bottom.

_sectionTypes.recent: Automated. Newest-imaged records. Fields: title, types (e.g. ['Object','Specimen']), count.
_sectionTypes.pool: Your hand-picked objects, shown a random few each visit. Fields: title, items (object/specimen/... ids or hrefs), count, shuffle.
_sectionTypes.query: A random selection from a search or collection. Fields: title, query (a search string, e.g. 'collection:"Photography"' or 'hei tiki'), count, shuffle, type (optional, restrict to one record type).
_sectionTypes.links: Quick-search chips. Fields: title, items ([{label, query}]).

banner._help: Full-width banner image at the top of the home page. image is a Te Papa media URL; caption is shown over the bottom of the image. href (optional) makes the banner clickable.
banner.caption: Dominion Museum Education Box /suitcase, Wellington, by Dominion Museum. CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Te Papa (ME024351)

hero._help: The intro text block. eyebrow/title/subtitle/description are all optional and editable; omit one to hide it.
hero.title: Explore Te Papa's collections
hero.subtitle: Aotearoa New Zealand's national collection — search above, or browse the selections below.
description: An alternate view on Te Papa's Collections via the API.To visually browse relationships, select an object to go into detail view, then click "Explore relationship graph"
This site is an experiment built with Claude Code with Opus 4.8

categories._help: Collection links shown to the right of the intro. source:"collections" auto-lists every collection from the API with live counts (options: showCounts, sort "count"|"name", min). Add groups:[{ title, collections:[tokens] }] to split them into labelled columns — tokens are the API's collection values, e.g. TaongaMāori, FossilVertebrates. Any collection not listed in a group joins the last one. Or give a curated items:[{ label, query }] instead.
categories.title: Browse the collections

stats._help: The hero number band — live counts pulled from the API. Each item is { label, count }, where count is a query string, { query, recordType }, or { query, filters: [{ field, keyword }] }.

sections.title: James Bragge — Wellington to the Manawatū
sections.blurb: Follow the photographer’s wet-plate camera up the old coach road over the Remutaka Range and through the Wairarapa to the Manawatū Gorge — every photograph placed on a map.
